_note: Place visits: the Rhondda and Bethesda and Dyffryn Ogwen.
common.back_note: Folding back without placing threads resolves adequately.
common.tests_note: Judged across many runs, on the decision, after you fold back.
common.none_yet: No threads placed yet. Pick up to {n} on the model.
rhondda.history: From the 1850s two narrow valleys filled with pits and terraces. Output peaked around 1913. The last Rhondda pit closed in 1990, and the tips stayed.
rhondda.tip_source_bgs: BGS landslide record on or near a tip
rhondda.wimd_deprived: in the most deprived tenth of Wales
rhondda.rule_sentence: Below means within {d} m of the tip and at least {h} m lower than its base.
rhondda.rule_slider: Distance counted as below, in metres
rhondda.rule_note: A crude proxy, not an engineering assessment. Change the distance and the counts update.
rhondda.rule_register: The official register of disused coal tips exists but is not open data, so it is not used here.
rhondda.tests.exposure: Exposure: your threads cover a fair share of the homes below all the tips, weighted by risk.
rhondda.tests.fairness: Fairness: at least one thread protects a neighbourhood in the most deprived tenth.
rhondda.tests.lifelines: Lifelines: no tip left at high risk sits above a school or the railway.
bethesda.prompt: Three threads to tie the quarry to the valley.
bethesda.dilemma: The visitors have come to the quarry. Does the valley’s next generation get a home, work and a Welsh-speaking street out of it, or does it pass through?
bethesda.history: Penrhyn quarry was once the largest slate quarry in the world. The lockout of 1900 to 1903 split the valley. The slate landscape became a World Heritage Site in 2021.
bethesda.requires: Only works if {card} is in play.
bethesda.half_without: Half strength unless {card} has been played.
bethesda.river_flips: Turns against the river in dry summers.
bethesda.tests.aros: Aros (staying): young adults can stay. Needs a Homes thread and a Work thread to pay off.
bethesda.tests.iaith: Iaith: Welsh stays the language of the street.
bethesda.tests.pwysau: Pwysau (pressure): visitors, lorries and the river stay within what the valley can carry.
bethesda.facts_note: Facts carry “to check” until a source is confirmed.
rhondda.prompt.one: The money covers one tip this term. There are more tips than thread.
rhondda.prompt.other: The money covers {n} tips this term. There are more tips than thread.
bethesda.about: The place, and what it will judge
